parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPv6 address for which an IPv6 egress-only rule is configured.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the instance for which you want to configure an IPv6 egress-only rule. Valid values:

- IPv6Address (default): The instance is a single IPv6 address.
- IPv6Prefix: The instance is an IPv6 CIDR block.

parameters.name: Ipv6EgressOnlyRuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPv6 egress-only rule to query.

parameters.name: Ipv6GatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the IPv6 gateway.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the IPv6 gateway. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.
